name: Magnify Vision
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 2, druid 2, machinesmith 1, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF / M (magnifying glass)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

This spells doubles the range of your vision. If you have darkvision, this doubles the range of it for the duration of the spell.
